description: Frozen analytical inputs for the Monte-Carlo and factorial diagnostic experiments. These are derived numerical artefacts, not broadcast text: each is a float32 sentence-embedding matrix with no string content. The transcripts they encode are NOT redistributed.
why_not_regenerable: The experiments are defined on these exact realisations and are hash-gated. Re-encoding the corpus in a different environment yields a different array and a different experiment.

highlight_embedding_realisation_A.npy.consumed_by: resampling stability (200 resamples); alternative geometry (100 replicates); held-out factorial cell A

category_labels.reason: the canonical partition the experiments score against is reproduced byte-identically by this release (results/<corpus>/cache/<corpus>__labels__mcs35.npy), so no label file is shipped. The historical labels_113.csv additionally carried raw and masked transcript text and is deliberately NOT redistributed.
